description: Salesflare helps users find and manage CRM accounts, contacts, opportunities, pipelines, tags, tasks, and users from ChatGPT. The app can list CRM records, inspect an account feed, create new accounts, contacts, opportunities, and tasks, and update existing CRM records in the user's Salesflare workspace.
